'''Biljana Stojković''' ({{lang-sr-Cyrl|Биљана Стојковић}}; born 6 October 1972) is a Serbian biologist, activist, and professor at the [[University of Belgrade]] Faculty of Biology. Stojković was the presidential candidate of the [[We Must (Serbia)|We Must]] coalition in the [[2022 Serbian presidential election]].

== Early life ==
Stojković was born on 6 October 1972 in [[Belgrade]], [[SR Serbia]], [[SFR Yugoslavia]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Biljana Stojković |url=https://www.istinomer.rs/akter/biljana-stojkovic/ |access-date=13 March 2022 |website=Istinomer |language=sr-RS}}</ref><ref group="‡">{{Cite web |title=dr Biljana Stojković |url=https://www.bio.bg.ac.rs/osoblje/stojkovic-biljana |access-date=13 March 2022 |website=Biološki fakultet |language=sr}}</ref> She attended the [[Zemun Gymnasium]], and in 1991, she enrolled into the Faculty of Biology at the [[University of Belgrade]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=Popović |first=Sofija |date=27 February 2022 |title=Predsednička kandidatkinja Biljana Stojković: Profesorka sa aktivizmom u genima |url=https://www.vreme.com/vesti/kandidatkinja-za-predsednicu-biljana-stojkovic-profesorka-sa-aktivizmom-u-genima/ |access-date=13 March 2022 |website=Vreme |language=sr-RS}}</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite web |last=Radovanović |first=Rade |date=9 August 2020 |title=Biljana Stojković: Kraj despotije je vrlo blizu |url=https://www.danas.rs/nedelja/biljana-stojkovic-kraj-despotije-je-vrlo-blizu/ |access-date=13 March 2022 |website=Danas |language=sr-RS}}</ref> She graduated in 1996, and in 1999 she received her master's degree.<ref name=":2" /> At one point, Stojković stayed in [[Switzerland]] in 1999, and there, she was offered to finish her postgraduate studies at the [[University of Basel]], although she declined the offer and instead, she finished the studies in Belgrade.<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":2" /> She received her PhD in 2007.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":3">{{Cite web |last=Andrić |first=Vesna |date=11 December 2019 |title=Biljana Stojković: Lekcije iz solidarnosti |url=https://www.danas.rs/ljudi/biljana-stojkovic-lekcije-iz-solidarnosti/ |access-date=13 March 2022 |website=Danas |language=sr-RS}}</ref>

== Career ==
[[File:Biljana Stojković 2017.jpg|thumb|Stojković in 2017]]
Stojković began her career as an assistant at the University of Belgrade in 1997, a role which she held until 2008. She was promoted to an assistant professor in 2008, and in 2013, she became an associate professor. In 2018, she became a full professor at the university. She teaches [[genetics]] and [[evolution]], and at the [[Faculty of Philosophy, University of Belgrade|Faculty of Philosophy]], she also teaches genetics as an elective subject.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":3" /> Throughout her career, she has primarily worked on studies regarding genetics and evolution.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Đorđević |first=Katarina |date=8 February 2008 |title=Plave oči balkanske |url=https://www.politika.rs/sr/clanak/32265/Drustvo/Plave-oci-balkanske |access-date=13 March 2022 |website=Politika |language=sr}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Bubnjević |first=Slobodan |date=7 October 2009 |title=Žena koja je nedostajala |url=https://www.vreme.com/mozaik/zena-koja-je-nedostajala/ |access-date=13 March 2022 |website=Vreme |language=sr-RS}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=12 February 2015 |title=Grci najstariji narod na Balkanu?! |url=https://nationalgeographic.rs/priroda/zemlja/a16362/grci-najstariji-narod-na-balkanu.html |access-date=13 March 2022 |website=National Geographic |language=sr}}</ref> Stojković gained notoriety as a scientist who has opposed to expel [[Darwin's theory]] from school curricula, and she was one of the few professors at the University of Belgrade who publicly supported the student blockade of the [[Captain Miša's Mansion|rectorate]] in 2019.<ref name=":3" /><ref>{{Cite web |last=Todorović |first=Sonja |date=6 May 2017 |title=Pet stručnjaka za "Blic" razbija peticiju protiv Darvina u paramparčad |url=https://www.blic.rs/vesti/drustvo/pet-strucnjaka-za-blic-razbija-peticiju-protiv-darvina-u-paramparcad/fg8779n |access-date=13 March 2022 |website=Blic |language=sr}}</ref>

=== Politics ===
Stojković was previously an [[independent politician]],<ref name=":1" /> while she describes herself as a [[Secular humanism|secular humanist]],<ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite web |last=Stojković |first=Biljana |date=22 August 2012 |title=Serbia and secularism |url=https://pescanik.net/serbia-and-secularism/ |access-date=13 March 2022 |website=Peščanik |language=en-US}}</ref> and she holds left-wing and [[Anti-war movement|anti-war]] views.<ref name=":2" /><ref name=":4">{{Cite web |last=Radovanović |first=Vojin |date=12 March 2022 |title=Biljana Stojković: Profesorka protiv Vučića |url=https://www.danas.rs/ljudi/biljana-stojkovic-profesorka-protiv-vucica/ |access-date=13 March 2022 |website=Danas |language=sr-RS}}</ref> She is an opponent of [[creationism]],<ref>{{Cite web |date=16 August 2015 |title=Darvinisti i kreacionisti |url=https://www.politika.rs/sr/clanak/335725/DARVINISTI-I-KREACIONISTI-3 |access-date=13 March 2022 |website=Politika |language=sr}}</ref> and she opposes [[religious studies]] as part of school curricula.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Karabeg |first=Omer |date=11 April 2009 |title=Nauka je na Balkanu luksuz |url=https://www.slobodnaevropa.org/a/most_nauka_luksuz/1606649.html |access-date=13 March 2022 |website=Radio Free Europe |language=sh}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Komarčević |first=Dušan |date=30 January 2014 |title=Tribina "Sekularnost i školstvo": Je li veronauci mesto u učionici? |url=https://www.slobodnaevropa.org/a/tribina-sekularnost-i-skolstvo-je-li-veronauci-mesto-u-ucionici/25248218.html |access-date=13 March 2022 |website=Radio Free Europe |language=sh}}</ref> Stojković has criticised the [[Serbian Progressive Party]], and has called [[Aleksandar Vučić]] an [[Autocracy|autocrat]].<ref name=":2" /><ref>{{Cite web |last=Kljajić |first=Sanja |date=20 August 2014 |title=Naprednjaci kopiraju nordijsku eugeniku |url=https://www.dw.com/sr/naprednjaci-kopiraju-nordijsku-eugeniku/a-17864524 |access-date=13 March 2022 |website=Deutsche Welle |language=sr-RS}}</ref> Ahead of the [[2022 Serbian general election|2022 presidential elections]], she claimed that she would not recognize [[Kosovo]] as an independent state, nor would she agree to Serbia's [[Enlargement of NATO|membership in NATO]] as president.<ref>{{Cite web |date=18 March 2022 |title=Biljana Stojković: Ne bih potpisala nezavisnost Kosova, nisam da Srbija uđe u NATO |url=https://www.danas.rs/vesti/politika/izbori22/biljana-stojkovic-ne-bih-potpisala-nezavisnost-kosova-nisam-da-srbija-udje-u-nato/ |access-date=18 March 2022 |website=Danas |language=sr-RS}}</ref> She participated in the protests throughout the 1990s, beginning with the [[1991 protests in Belgrade]]. Stojković had also opposed [[Slobodan Milošević]]'s regime.<ref name=":2" />

She was a member of the Assembly of Free Serbia organisation.<ref name=":1" /> The organisation initially cooperated with parties inside the [[United for the Victory of Serbia|United Serbia]] coalition, although in early February 2022, the organisation began cooperating with the [[We Must (Serbia)|We Must]] coalition.<ref>{{Cite web |date=7 February 2022 |title=Stojković: Više od 78 odsto članova SsS bilo za napuštanje Ujedinjene Srbije |url=https://rs.n1info.com/vesti/stojkovic-vise-od-78-odsto-clanova-sss-bilo-za-napustanje-ujedinjene-srbije/ |access-date=13 March 2022 |website=N1 |language=sr-RS}}</ref> On 27 February, the We Must coalition revealed Stojković as their presidential candidate.<ref>{{Cite web |date=27 February 2022 |title=Biljana Stojković predsednička kandidatkinja SSS i koalicije Moramo |url=https://rs.n1info.com/izbori-2022/predsednicki-izbori/biljana-stojkovic-predsednicka-kandidatkinja-sss-i-koalicije-moramo/ |access-date=13 March 2022 |website=N1 |language=sr-RS}}</ref> During the electoral campaign, Stojković stated her opposition to [[Particracy|partocracy]] and support for European integrations.<ref name=":4" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=11 March 2022 |title=Stojković: Demontirati partijsku državu |url=https://rs.n1info.com/izbori-2022/predsednicki-izbori/stojkovic-demontirati-partijsku-drzavu/ |access-date=13 March 2022 |website=N1 |language=sr-RS}}</ref> Stojković became one of the co-leaders of the [[Together (Serbia)|Together]] political party on 11 June.<ref>{{Cite web |date=11 June 2022 |title=Članice koalicije "Moramo" se ujedinile u "Zajedno" - stranku bez lidera |url=https://rs.n1info.com/vesti/clanice-koalicije-moramo-se-ujedinile-u-stranku-zajedno/ |access-date=11 June 2022 |website=N1 |language=sr-RS}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
She is married to Oliver Stojković, a [[geneticist]], and they have one son. Stojković is an author and she has published her work in international science magazines.<ref name=":3" /> She has been an editor for ''Peščanik'' since 2007.<ref name=":2" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=2 November 2007 |title=Ometeni u razvoju |url=https://pescanik.net/ometeni-u-razvoju/ |access-date=13 March 2022 |website=Peščanik |language=en-US}}</ref> She received the "A Good Example of New Optimism" award in 2019.<ref name=":3" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=18 November 2019 |title=Aleksandru Obradoviću i Biljani Stojković nagrada "Dobar primer novog optimizma" |url=https://rs.n1info.com/vesti/a544775-Aleksandru-Obradovicu-i-Biljani-Stojkovic-nagrada-Dobar-primer-novog-optimizma/ |access-date=13 March 2022 |website=N1 |language=sr-RS}}</ref>
